## What's Changed
* Default to Claude Opus 5.5 with refreshed benchmarks by @judagent[bot] in https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/pull/11
* Name the serving route on advisor errors and failed fallbacks by @judagent[bot] in https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/pull/12
* Guard error route-tagging against frozen rejections by @judagent[bot] in https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/pull/13


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/compare/v26.9.3...v26.9.4

## What's Changed
* Cross-provider benchmark matching + generator filename fix by @judagent[bot] in https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/pull/10


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/compare/v26.9.2...v26.9.3

## What's Changed
* Change default advisor effort from max to xhigh by @judagent[bot] in https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/pull/2
* TypeSafe gate, loading repair, and relaxed consultation guidance by @judagent[bot] in https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/pull/4
* fix: set npm version from the GitHub Release tag by @judagent[bot] in https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/pull/5
* feat: opt out advisor for selected caller models by @judagent[bot] in https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/pull/7
* Model-aware gate with refreshable Artificial Analysis benchmarks by @judagent[bot] in https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/pull/9

## New Contributors
* @judagent[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/pull/2

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pfoundation/ocAdvisorTool/compare/v26.9.1...v26.9.2
